default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

E-1258.title: Round-number touch rejection
E-1258.hypothesis: Index points at round multiples attract resting limit orders and psychological supply/demand; a bar that touches the next round level and closes back below it is absorbed, so fade.

E-1259.title: Narrowest-bar break follow
E-1259.hypothesis: The narrowest bar of the last n bars shows participants stepping aside; the first close beyond its extreme releases pent-up orders in that direction.

E-1260.title: Low-volume new-extreme fade
E-1260.hypothesis: A new session high/low printed on below-typical volume lacks participation; late chasers are trapped, so fade the bar's direction.

E-1261.title: Shrinking-body run fade
E-1261.hypothesis: Same-colour bars with each body smaller than the last show a push losing force; the other side steps in, so fade.

E-1262.title: Bollinger squeeze release follow
E-1262.hypothesis: Band width far below its typical size means volatility compression; the first close outside the band starts an expansion in that direction.

E-1263.title: Z-score stretch fade
E-1263.hypothesis: A close several standard deviations from its recent mean is a liquidity-driven overshoot that dealers fade back toward the mean.

E-1264.title: Previous clock-hour break follow
E-1264.hypothesis: The prior clock hour's high/low is a level traders watch; a close through it within the next hour shows a new hourly balance being resolved.

E-1265.title: Day-open reclaim follow
E-1265.hypothesis: After trading on one side of the session open for a while, a close back across it flips the day's bias; follow the cross.

E-1266.title: Stochastic exit-from-extreme turn
E-1266.hypothesis: A range-position oscillator leaving its extreme zone marks the end of a one-sided push inside the recent range; trade the bounce.

E-1267.title: Gap-open bar follow
E-1267.hypothesis: A bar that opens beyond the previous bar's extreme shows an aggressive order burst; if it closes in that direction the gap was not filled, so follow.
